Name: Fashion Sense - Wardrobe Manager
Author: NatrollEXE
Description:
[b][color=#c27ba0][size=5]Description[/size][/color][/b]
Fashion Sense Outfit Preview adds a small preview window and a button for expanded preview window to the saved outfits menu from Fashion Sense, allowing you to see how an outfit looks before equipping it.

I originally made this mod for personal use because I had a lot of saved outfits and kept getting lost while trying to find a specific one. Since Fashion Sense shows outfit names but does not provide a visual preview in the saved outfits list, I wanted a simple way to check the look first instead of equipping outfits blindly.

After making it work, I thought it might be useful for other players too, so I decided to share it.

[size=5][b][color=#ffffff]>[/color][color=#c27ba0]>[/color][color=#ffffff]>[/color][color=#c27ba0]>[/color][color=#ffffff]>[/color][color=#c27ba0]>[/color][color=#ffffff]>[/color][color=#c27ba0]>[/color][color=#ffffff]>[/color][color=#c27ba0]>[/color][color=#ffffff]>[/color][color=#c27ba0]>[/color][color=#ffffff]>[/color][color=#c27ba0]>[/color][color=#ffffff]>[/color][color=#c27ba0]>[/color][color=#ffffff]>[/color][color=#c27ba0]>[/color][color=#ffffff]>[/color][color=#c27ba0]>[/color][color=#ffffff]>[/color][color=#c27ba0]>[/color][color=#ffffff]>[/color][color=#c27ba0]>[/color][color=#ffffff]>[/color][color=#cc0000] [/color][color=#c27ba0][u]Updates![/u][/color] [color=#ffffff]<[/color][color=#c27ba0][size=5]<[/size][/color][color=#ffffff]<[/color][color=#c27ba0]<[/color][color=#ffffff]<[/color][color=#c27ba0]<[/color][color=#ffffff]<[/color][color=#c27ba0]<[/color][color=#ffffff]<[/color][color=#c27ba0]<[/color][color=#ffffff]<[/color][color=#c27ba0]<[/color][color=#ffffff]<[/color][color=#c27ba0]<[/color][color=#ffffff]<[/color][color=#c27ba0]<[/color][color=#ffffff]<[/color][color=#c27ba0]<[/color][color=#ffffff]<[/color][color=#c27ba0]<[/color][color=#ffffff]<[/color][color=#c27ba0]<[/color][color=#ffffff]<[/color][color=#c27ba0]<[/color][color=#ffffff]<[/color][color=#c27ba0]<[/color][color=#ffffff]<[/color][color=#c27ba0]<[/color][color=#ffffff]<[/color][/b][/size]
Over time, I kept adding new features to make large outfit collections easier to manage, including categories, tags, advanced filters, outfit management tools, and automatic outfit schedules. At that point, the mod was no longer focused only on previewing outfits, so its original name no longer represented everything it had become.
For that reason, starting with version 1.0.7, I decided to rename it [b][color=#c27ba0]Fashion Sense - Wardrobe Manager[/color][/b]. It is still the same project and continues to include the original preview features, but the new name better reflects its broader purpose as an in-game wardrobe companion for Fashion Sense.

[color=#c27ba0][size=5][b]Installation Instructions[/b][/size][/color]
1. Install SMAPI.
2. Install Fashion Sense.
3. Download this mod.
4. Extract the folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
5. Launch the game through SMAPI.

[color=#c27ba0][size=5][b]How to Use[/b][/size][/color]
- Open the saved outfits menu in Fashion Sense.
- Click the [b]Expand[/b] button to open the full outfit browser.
- Browse your outfits in a larger interface with a live preview of your farmer on the right side.
- You can also hold [b]CTRL[/b] and left-click an outfit for a quick preview without opening the expanded menu.

Note: The configured preview shortcut will always be used together with the left mouse button.
[color=#ffffff]Designed to make navigating large Fashion Sense clothing collections easier, especially for players with hundreds of saved looks. ([/color][b][color=#c27ba0]like me LOL[/color][color=#ffffff]) [/color][/b]

[color=#c27ba0][size=5][b]Automatic Outfit Schedules[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#ffffff]The expanded outfit browser also includes a fully visual scheduler that can automatically change your saved Fashion Sense outfits. No JSON editing or special outfit naming convention is required.
Use the seasonal and schedule tabs on the left side of the expanded browser:[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#ffffff]Spring, Summer, Fall, and Winter — rules created inside these tabs only apply during their respective season.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]Festivals — create rules for vanilla festivals and optionally show festivals added by other mods.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]Daily — general everyday rules that can work during any season.[/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b][color=#c27ba0]Creating a schedule[/color][/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#ffffff]Open one of the schedule tabs.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]Click “New schedule”.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]Choose the conditions you want to use.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]Click “Select outfits” and choose one or more saved Fashion Sense outfits.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]Leave the schedule enabled and confirm your selection.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#ffffff]Depending on the selected tab, a schedule can use:[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#ffffff]All days, one specific day, or multiple days from 1 to 28.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]One or multiple weather conditions.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]Any time period, morning, afternoon, or night.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]One or multiple exact times. Exact times are optional.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]One or multiple locations, including the Farmhouse, indoor or outdoor locations, and a selection of vanilla areas.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]A specific festival or multiple festivals.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#ffffff]Conditions selected in the same schedule work together. For example, you can create a Spring schedule for day 14, during nighttime, inside the Farmhouse, at 10:00 PM.
The scheduler checks your rules when a save is loaded, when a new day begins, when the player changes location, and as the in-game clock changes.[/color]

[b][color=#c27ba0][size=4]Selecting outfits, categories, and tags[/size][/color][/b]
[color=#ffffff]The outfit selection window can be used in two different ways:[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#ffffff]Use categories, tags, and color tags as filters, then manually select only the outfits you want for that schedule.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]Select “Whole tag” to use an entire tag as a dynamic outfit group.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#ffffff]A dynamic tag always uses the outfits currently assigned to it. For example, if a schedule uses the whole “Green” color tag, any outfit you later add to that tag automatically becomes available to the schedule.
You can combine individually selected outfits with one or more dynamic tags. Duplicate outfits are removed automatically.
If multiple valid outfits are available, the scheduler chooses one at random whenever that rule is activated or reevaluated.[/color]

[b][color=#c27ba0][size=4]Schedule priority[/size][/color][/b]
[color=#ffffff]When more than one schedule matches:[/color]
[list=1]
[*][color=#ffffff]Festival schedules have the highest priority.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]Seasonal schedules come next.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]Daily schedules act as general fallback rules.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#ffffff]More specific rules, such as a particular day or schedules with additional conditions, are prioritized over broader rules in the same section.
Schedules are stored separately for each save file and can be enabled, disabled, edited, or deleted from the visual interface.[/color]
[heading][color=#c27ba0][size=5]Important Notes and Compatibility[/size][/color][/heading]
[list]
[*][color=#ffffff]A schedule needs at least one valid saved outfit or a dynamic tag containing outfits. If a selected tag is empty, the schedule will remain saved but cannot change the farmer’s outfit until an outfit is assigned to that tag.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]If an outfit used by a schedule is deleted, it will no longer be available to that rule. Dynamic tags automatically follow their current outfit assignments.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]Festival schedules have the highest priority, followed by seasonal schedules. Daily schedules work as general fallback rules.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]When two rules from the same section match, the more specific rule is prioritized. A rule using a specific day, weather, period, location, festival, or exact time is considered more specific than a broad rule.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]Weather Wonders has direct built-in support, including its additional weather conditions.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]Weather types added by other mods are also supported. Unknown custom weather IDs can be detected when that weather is currently active and can then be selected and saved in a schedule.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]Custom active and passive festivals can optionally be displayed in the festival selector.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]Automatic outfit mods may conflict if more than one tries to equip an outfit at the same time.[/color][/*]
[/list][heading][color=#c27ba0][size=5]Another Automatic Outfit Option[/size][/color][/heading]
[color=#ffffff]If you prefer a ready-made automatic outfit system based on outfit naming conventions and predefined situations, please also check out [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38381]Auto-change Outfits by ahomiepassingby[/url]. [/b]

Since both mods can automatically change Fashion Sense outfits, using both automation systems at the same time may cause them to compete over which outfit should be equipped. To avoid unexpected outfit changes, use only one automatic outfit system at a time.[/color]

[color=#c27ba0][size=5][b]Main Features[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Expanded outfit browser with a live character preview before equipping.[/*]
[*]Search bar to filter outfits by name.[/*]
[*]Custom outfit categories — create and delete your own groups (e.g. Summer, Winter, Festival) to keep your outfits organized.[/*]
[*]Outfit tags and color tags — label outfits with your own tags (e.g. Fun, Beauty, Pink, Blue) for quick filtering.[/*]
[*]Advanced filter panel — combine category, tags, and color tags to narrow down your outfit list exactly the way you want.[/*]
[*]Quick preview still available via CTRL + left-click for a faster look without opening the full browser.[/*]
[*]You can rename saved outfits by right-clicking on them.[/*]
[*]Save or delete a saved outfit.[/*]
[*]Visual outfit scheduler — automatically equip saved Fashion Sense outfits based on season, date, weather, time period, exact time, location, or festival.[/*]
[*]Multiple outfit selection — choose several outfits and let the scheduler select one at random.[/*]
[*]Dynamic tag schedules — use an entire outfit tag or color tag and automatically include future outfits assigned to it.[/*]
[*]Flexible outfit selection — use categories and tags only as filters, or include a whole tag dynamically.[/*]
[*]Festival priority — festival schedules take priority over seasonal and daily schedules.[/*]
[*]Weather Wonders integration — select its additional weather conditions directly from the scheduler.[/*]
[*]Custom weather compatibility — weather types added by other mods can be detected while active and saved in schedule rules.[/*]
[*]Modded festival discovery — optionally display active and passive festivals added by other mods.[/*]
[*]Per-save schedules — each farmer can have their own independent outfit rules.[/*]
[/list][color=#c27ba0][size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Fashion Sense[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (optional)[/*]
[/list]
